title: 数字与单位
goal: 能转换大数并保留数量单位。

points.label: 转换中文大数与英文计数单位
保留数值对应的单位与数量关系

sources.title: 大学英语六级考试大纲

body.p: 中文的大数以万和亿为单位。英文的大数三位一组，单位是 thousand、million 和 billion。翻译时先换算数值，再确定计量单位。

body.box:
原文：该县人口约为十二万。
译文：The county has a population of about 120,000.

body.p: 十二万写作 120,000，也可以说 120 thousand。数字后面的计量名词随数值变单复数：one kilometre，300 kilometres。

cards.title: 大数单位
rows: The town has ten thousand residents.
The town has one hundred thousand residents.
The region has one million residents.
The country has one hundred million residents.
The country has one billion residents.

cards.title: 人口与面积
rows: The country has a population of 100 million.
这个湖的面积为两万平方千米。
这个公园的面积为一平方千米。
The park covers one square kilometre.

cards.title: 长度与年份
rows: The tunnel is one kilometre long.
这座桥于一九八八年开放。
这家博物馆于二〇〇五年建立。

items.stem: 原文：这座城市有人口五十万。选择译句。
options: The city has a population of 50,000.
The city has a population of 500,000.
The city has a population of 5,000,000.
The city has a population of 5,000.
items.why: 五十万等于 500,000，第二项保留人口数值。

items.stem: 原文：这个公园占地两平方千米。选择译句。
options: The park covers two square kilometre.
The park covers two thousand square metres.
The park covers two square kilometres.
The park covers two kilometres.
items.why: 原文的面积单位是平方千米。第三项用 square kilometres，two 后面用复数。第一项单位用了单数。

items.stem: 原文：这片地区有人口三百万。补全译句 The region has a population of ____. 用数字 3 加英文计数单位。
原文：这座桥长一千米。补全译句 The bridge is ____ long. 用数字 1 加英式英文单位。
items.why: 一千米写作 1 kilometre，单位用单数。

items.stem: 原文：这个地区有人口两亿。选择译句。
options: The region has a population of 20 million.
The region has a population of 2 million.
The region has a population of 2 billion.
The region has a population of 200 million.
items.why: 一亿是 100 million，两亿是 200 million。

items.stem: 原文：这个展馆在二〇一二年开放。选择译句。
options: The hall opened in 2012.
The hall opened in 2021.
The hall opened in 2002.
The hall opened in 2011.

items.stem: 原文：该市有一百万人口。选择译句。
options: The city has a population of one hundred thousand.
The city has a population of ten million.
The city has a population of one million.
The city has a population of one billion.

items.stem: 原文：该地区有人口三亿。选择译句。
options: The region has a population of 30 million.
The region has a population of 300 million.
The region has a population of 3 million.
The region has a population of 3 billion.

items.stem: 原文：这条河长一千米。选择译句。
options: The river is one square kilometre in length.
The river is one kilometres in length.
The river is one thousand kilometres in length.
The river is one kilometre in length.
items.why: 一千米即 one kilometre。第四项数值是 one，长度单位用单数 kilometre。

items.stem: 原文：这座车站于一九九六年开放。选择译句。
options: The station opened in 1996.
The station opened in 1969.
The station opened in 1896.
The station opened in 1995.

items.stem: 原文：这座城镇人口为四十万。补全译句 The town has a population of ____. 用数字 400 加英文计数单位。
原文：该地区人口为五亿。补全译句 The region has a population of ____. 用数字 500 加英文计数单位。
原文：这座岛面积为三平方千米。补全译句 The island covers ____. 用数字 3 加英式英文面积单位。
items.why: 面积为三平方千米，kilometres 用复数。

items.stem: 原文：这条道路长二十千米。补全译句 The road is ____ long. 用数字 20 加英式英文长度单位。
items.why: 长度为二十千米，kilometres 用复数。
